# Release Status

This is the canonical editable QMD source for the Tools engineering design
manual. It is a governance scaffold, not a released engineering manual. The
file-level module inventory is complete for its declared tracked-source
denominator, but all detected calculation candidates remain provisional and
the stable calculation-pathway registry remains empty. Release remains blocked
by TOOLS-D2 through TOOLS-D9. No generated HTML, LaTeX, PDF, or DOCX artifact
is approved.
